summary: Iteration 9 focused testing of the user-reported bug: hard-delete of packets from the process register now correctly frees weight back to the kapan's Un-packeted figure. Added TestPacketDelete class (5 new tests) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all 59/59 backend tests pass (54 existing + 5 new). Frontend UI verified end-to-end: no packet-stock-table anywhere, un-issued packets appear as amber rows inside the single process register (data-testid stock-row-{packetNo}) with Jangad '—' + 'In Stock' badge, printer link and trash icon; deleting via the trash button shows the confirm dialog mentioning the returned cts, hard-deletes via DELETE /api/packets/{id}, reduces stock_weight and increases unpacketed_weight by the same amount (70.00 -> 80.00 for a 10.00 ct packet), balance bar stays BALANCED, 'Print labels (n)' count updates, staff RBAC hides the trash and DELETE returns 403. All the exact features listed in the review request were verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1035 lines — consider splitting into routers/domain modules for maintainability (kapan, packets, entries, jangads, print, users).
delete_packet correctly hard-deletes; unpacketed_weight is derived (kapan.weight - sum(packet.original_weight)) so no manual reconciliation update is needed. This is a clean design.
Frontend removePacket() uses window.confirm with the exact cts returned — good UX; consider migrating to shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app in the future (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own TEST_/IT9xxxx kapan and deletes it at the end. The user's kapan 101.35 was NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 bug fix verified. Next iterations can rely on: (a) TestPacketDelete covers hard-delete + weight-free + RBAC + entries-block; (b) UI stock-row-{packetNo}, packet-delete-{packetNo}, print-label-{packetNo}, print-all-labels-button all exist and update reactively after delete. Toast 'Packet deleted' is shown on success. data-testid packet-stock-table has been removed and MUST stay removed.
rca of the issue: The kapan report's unpacketed_weight is computed as kapan.weight - sum(packet.original_weight over active packets). Previously the UI had no packet-level trash icon after the standalone Packets tab was removed — the only trash on the register deleted the JANGAD ENTRY (design: returns packet to stock, weight remains allocated). Iteration 9 fix: (1) removed the separate amber PacketStockTable; (2) merged un-issued packets into the process register as amber rows; (3) each stock row now has a trash icon calling DELETE /api/packets/{id}, which enforces can_delete + refuses when entries exist + hard-deletes the packet document, causing unpacketed_weight to jump back up by exactly the deleted packet's original_weight.
